# Hygeia Power Wash Solutions
> Silicon Valley's leading commercial hot-water pressure washing and residential soft-washing specialists. Automated monthly curbside trash bin sanitization from $35/mo. State of California DVBE Certified (#2054658).

## Primary Services & Pricing
- Automated Trash Bin Cleaning: $35/mo subscription (bi-weekly visits), $200°F high-pressure wash, hospital-grade eco-disinfection, deodorizing.
- Commercial Pressure Washing: Parking garages, dumpster pads, retail storefront walkways, commercial fleet washing, graffiti remediation.
- Residential Soft Washing: Stucco, siding, roofs, driveways, paver restoration, and patio cleaning.
- Water Recovery Protocols: Full EPA Clean Water Act wastewater vacuum recovery and compliant disposal.
